definition: **HHT（Osler-Weber-Rendu）為體染色體顯性遺傳，肝臟受侵犯常見但多數無症狀。** CT 表現：dilated hepatic arteries、portal/hepatic vein early filling（A-V/A-P shunting）、biliary abnormality。
keyPoints: 臨床三聯：mucocutaneous telangiectases + epistaxis + visceral AVMs
肝臟受侵犯：**有肝臟 AVM 的病人很多，但 symptomatic liver involvement 少見**
CT：dilated hepatic arteries、arterial phase 早期 portal/hepatic vein filling、biliary changes
name: HHT Liver Involvement
